description:
## Playback loading

- Enjoy an updated loading screen with movie and TV artwork, animated title-logo progress, and the Phantom ghost when a title logo is unavailable.
- See buffering progress as your stream gets ready. Playback begins as soon as enough has loaded.
- Switch servers while a stream is loading without waiting for it to finish buffering.

## Interface improvements

- Refined the bottom navigation with a softer, transparent background that blends into the content behind your phone’s navigation buttons.
- Cleaned up the app’s appearance on startup by removing the solid theme-colored strip at the top.
- Removed unnecessary loading animations above search results for a cleaner search experience.

releases.description:
## Trakt and SIMKL

- Correct Trakt imports for watched history, Continue Watching progress and recommendations.
- Refresh connected-account Home sections after connection and sync so imported content can appear without restarting the app.
- Share Trakt and SIMKL connections between phone and TV when signed into the same Phantom account.
- Make activation links openable and add buttons to copy device activation codes.

## Theme selection and previews

- Fix switching between preset themes and custom colors so a previous custom color no longer overrides the selected preset.
- Apply the saved accent when screens open and refresh it when the selected theme changes.
- Make profile previews follow the current solid-color or gradient selection.
- Keep custom color edits in the picker until confirmed; cancelling preserves the previous selection.
- Preserve normal and disabled control colors when updating the accent.

## Torrent cache controls

- Restore torrent cache controls in Playback settings.
- Choose Automatic or a 1, 2, 5, 10, 20 or 50 GB cache limit.
- Choose whether to clear cached torrent data after playback closes or retain it for reuse. Clear after playback is enabled by default.
- View cache storage usage and manually clear unused cached files without interrupting active playback.
- Automatically remove older unused cache when space is needed, and verify retained files before reusing them.
- Cache limits apply to the next torrent and must accommodate the selected video; they are not rolling buffer limits.

## App size

- Reduce the ARM64 APK from approximately 60.9 MiB to 48.4 MiB.
- Optimize bundled artwork without reducing image quality.
- Retain VLC and the built-in torrent engine.

- Refresh connected-account Home sections after connection and sync so imported content can appear without restarting the app.
- Share Trakt and SIMKL connections between phone and TV when signed into the same Phantom account.
- Make activation links openable and add buttons to copy device activation codes.

## Theme selection and previews

- Fix switching between preset themes and custom colors so a previous custom color no longer overrides the selected preset.
- Apply the saved accent when screens open and refresh it when the selected theme changes.
- Make profile previews follow the current solid-color or gradient selection.
- Keep custom color edits in the picker until confirmed; cancelling preserves the previous selection.
- Preserve normal and disabled control colors when updating the accent.

## Torrent cache controls

- Restore torrent cache controls in Playback settings.
- Choose Automatic or a 1, 2, 5, 10, 20 or 50 GB cache limit.
- Choose whether to clear cached torrent data after playback closes or retain it for reuse. Clear after playback is enabled by default.
- View cache storage usage and manually clear unused cached files without interrupting active playback.
- Automatically remove older unused cache when space is needed, and verify retained files before reusing them.
- Cache limits apply to the next torrent and must accommodate the selected video; they are not rolling buffer limits.

## App size

- Reduce the ARM64 APK from approximately 60.9 MiB to 48.4 MiB.
- Optimize bundled artwork without reducing image quality.
- Retain VLC and the built-in torrent engine.
